endings.title: Junior Emergency Dungeon Organizer
panels: Milo returns to the festival with a clipboard.
The blocks settle into friendlier corners.

lines.text: Milo is hereby promoted to Junior Emergency Dungeon Organizer.
Acceptable corners are a fine beginning.

endings.title: The Block Listener
panels: Milo invites the Block-O-Matic to the festival.
The dungeon unfolds into safe festival games.

lines.text: Would you like to come to the festival as a guest?
Response: yes. Festival status: imperfect, audible, accepted.

endings.title: Festival Grace Variant
panels: One crooked floor square begins to dance.

lines.text: The rhythm is irregular.
Yes. Would you like the first dance?

endings.title: Emergency Festival Baker
panels: The Cake Stall reopens.
Pippa pins NO PREHEAT WITHOUT PURPOSE above the oven.

lines.text: The cakes smell like three hours of work, six ruined towels, and victory.
Gloop?

endings.title: The Hearthkeeper of Brixonia
panels: A long table unfolds from Bloxley's banquet hall.
Pippa places a square cake with a soft center in the middle.

lines.text: This cake is square, but the center is soft.
Take a bite before filing a royal complaint.

endings.title: Festival Flambe Variant
panels: A harmless golden fire blooms above a cake.

lines.text: Festival Flambe has passed safety review.
Barely is still baked.

endings.title: Questionable Gadget Supervisor
panels: Zuzu gathers clamps and springs into a rolling toolbox.
New warning labels appear across the festival.

lines.text: My repairs saved the festival from several problems, including possibly two that were mine.
Warning-label compliance improved.

endings.title: The Public Safety Engineer
panels: Zuzu opens the Public Test Garden.
Every invention has a readable label and a reachable stop lever.

lines.text: No hidden overrides. No surprise participants. No clamp without a release lever.
It is at least a well-aligned lever.

endings.title: Festival Overclock Variant
panels: Fireworks bloom into wrench-shaped stars.

lines.text: Perfect. Terrifying. I have never been prouder of a non-explosion.

endings.title: Festival Freezer Keeper
panels: Nixie's ice cream cart reopens.
Some flavor labels remain shy.

lines.text: Some flavors are still shy. I will not rush them.
Frozen dessert availability restored. Public joy rising.

endings.title: The Gentle Thaw
panels: Every flavor name returns to Nixie's ledger.
Bloxley receives a round scoop in a square cup.

lines.text: They were waiting to be called by name.
I find this arrangement tolerable.

endings.title: Aurora Variant
panels: The festival square becomes a harmless snowlight rink.

lines.text: A little shimmer is allowed, if everyone lands softly.

endings.title: Captain of Festival Provisions
panels: Bruk repairs the snack table with royal blocks.
A polite line forms for seconds.

lines.text: Let the table stand. Let the line move kindly. Let no snack be left behind.
Gloop? Seconds?

endings.title: The Knight of the Shared Table
panels: The palace becomes the Hall of Many Plates.
Bruk places his shield at the center as a serving tray.

lines.text: This table is uneven.
More guests arrived than expected. Hospitality often is inefficient.

endings.title: Festival Banquet Parade Variant
panels: The snack table grows wheels and marches under lanterns.

lines.text: A table that cannot reach hungry guests must be carried.

endings.title: The Star Lantern Decorator
panels: Lumi repairs paper stars.
Some wishes still flicker at the edge of the palace.

lines.text: Not every star comes home at once. Some need another night.

endings.title: The Wishkeeper of Falling Stars
panels: Lumi releases every wishlight gathered from the stages.
The lights form a path, not a square.

lines.text: Now everyone has a way back.
Festival sky configuration: acceptably wonderful.

endings.title: Meteor Parade Variant
panels: A meteor sparkle loops around the jelly fountain.

lines.text: Meteor Parade approved. Future meteors must register at the lantern booth.
